residents.name: Sai
residents.notes: high-protein focus (eggs, paneer, chicken at nearly every meal); dislikes karela, bottle gourd (lauki), pumpkin (kaddu); asked for bhindi to be permanently removed

cook.name: Netravati
cook.schedule: Twice daily - 6:30 AM (lunch prep) and 6:30 PM (dinner prep), Mon-Sat; breakfast self-managed by residents
cook.language: Kannada/Hindi (voice notes; send reference photos for ingredients prone to mix-up)
notes: House key with the building guard when residents are away.
Sends 6:30 AM pantry photos and evening perishable photos.
Any dish first cooked on the trial day must be replicated with that EXACT recipe (grilled chicken salad dressing was simplified once).

slot_ingredient_bans.note: Never serve rice twice in a day - rice at lunch, roti at dinner.

dish_keyword_rules.note: Fish only grilled or Indian-style marinated - never curried.
Chicken must be Indian-style tomato-onion based only - never butter-garlic or Western/creamy prep.
Prawns: basic tomato-onion semi-gravy, low oil/butter - no garlic-butter style.

weekday_rules.note: Tuesday is vegetarian - chicken is swapped for paneer without exception.

brand_rules.note: Chicken breast 450 g pack; Godrej Real Good is the accepted fallback.
Low-fat paneer only; Milky Mist High Protein Low Fat as substitute.
Basmati reserved for pulao/biryani; Sona Masoori (5 kg) for daily meals.

ingredient_grade_rules.rule: Low-fat paneer only. Paneer at LUNCH is served with rice + dal, never with roti.
Indian-style tomato-onion base only; cook only the quantity needed (a full packet was nearly cooked when half was needed).
Rotation pool is beans, carrot, cabbage, cauliflower, spinach, beetroot - never the same sabji on consecutive days unless inventory-driven.
Rotate brown chana, chole, rajma - one per cycle; send a reference photo for chana varieties before soaking.

breakfast_style: Self-managed: overnight oats + 3 boiled eggs each, or dosa/poha/egg variants with tea.

cooking_technique.protein: Chicken or paneer present at BOTH lunch and dinner, never the same protein at both meals on the same day
cooking_technique.fish: Grilled or Indian-style marinated only - never curried
cooking_technique.oil_ghee: Light on oil/ghee across the board - no ghee roast
cooking_technique.recipe_fidelity: Trial-day recipes replicated exactly, no simplified versions

nutrition_direction: High-protein diet (Sai) - eggs, paneer, chicken emphasised at nearly every meal
standing_instructions: Breakfast is self-managed - cook handles lunch and dinner only.
Chicken or paneer at both lunch and dinner; never the same protein twice in a day.
Never rice twice in the same day; paneer at lunch goes with rice + dal, never roti.
Vegetable rotation: beans, carrot, cabbage, cauliflower, spinach, beetroot; no sabji repeated on consecutive days.
Legume rotation: brown chana, chole, rajma.
Leftovers may be reheated up to 2 days; inform residents before discarding.
Reference photos before cooking for any ingredient with variety confusion (kala vs kabuli chana).
Grocery orders only 8-10 AM or 6-10 PM; verify pantry stock first; cart screenshots must show the total.
non_negotiables: Never the same protein at lunch and dinner; never rice twice a day.
Chicken Indian-style only; fish never curried.
notes: Cabbage is IN the rotation pool for this house (unlike Gurupriyan & Raksha).
